#!/bin/bash
echo 'FAIL early: half a diagnosis' >&2
sleep 5
echo 'FAIL late: too late' >&2
exit 1

#!/bin/bash
echo 'WARN ollama: not running' >&2
echo 'FAIL typings: missing' >&2
exit 1

cases.name: failing checks reach the model through additionalContext, and the hook still exits 0

expect.context: session-doctor: `orkeon-bench doctor` reports failing checks in this workshop

cases.name: the failing lines of the doctor are passed as they are
a session that starts after /clear is told too

expect.context: FAIL esbuild: esbuild not found on PATH

cases.name: nothing is said when every check passes
nothing is said after a compaction: the session already knows
nothing is said without orkeon-bench
HARNESS_SESSION_DOCTOR=0 disables the hook
a doctor that does not answer in time is dropped, not half reported
a doctor that fails without a check line says nothing the model could misread
the failing lines travel on stderr, as orkeon-bench doctor -q writes them, and the shell's own noise is dropped

expect.context: FAIL esbuild: esbuild not found on PATH

cases.name: a doctor that exits 0 says nothing, whatever it printed
a timeout of 0 is not no limit: the default applies, and a quick doctor still reports

expect.context: FAIL esbuild: esbuild not found on PATH

cases.name: at most twenty failing checks are passed on
only the failing checks are passed on: a warning line of the doctor is not
a payload of another event is left alone
the output is one JSON object for the SessionStart event
cases.cmd: printf '%s' '{"hook_event_name":"SessionStart","source":"startup"}' | PATH={{FIX}}/fail:/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin bash {{CLAUDE}}/hooks/session-doctor.sh | jq -r '[.hookSpecificOutput.hookEventName, (.hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext | split("\n") | length)] | join(" lines=")'
